name: continuity
description: Session continuity engine. 'start' mode reads last 2 sessions + last 5 lessons for context injection. 'end' mode writes structured session summary, flushes pending writes, updates last.json.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 'start' to get cross-session context, 'end' to finalize current session

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Context blob for 'start', or session summary + graph update for 'end'
